text.title: Product Explainability Worked Example
text.summary: Prompt patterns for the two agent stages that need them: the KB extraction pass and the AI-answer probe pass, plus the KB validator reference.

section.title: Prompt patterns

example.title: KB extraction pass
example.code: You extract a structured product KB. Inputs: <homepage url>, <docs root>, <openapi spec>, <changelog>. Output JSON with fields: purpose (1 sentence, no marketing adjectives), capabilities[] (each: name, description, example, status: ga|beta|deprecated, since_version), limits[] (each: scope, rationale, workaround_or_null), use_cases[] (each: persona, job, success_signal), audience (industry, role, company_size), prerequisites[]. Refuse to invent fields. If a source is missing, write "unknown" -- never fabricate.

example.title: AI-answer probe pass
example.code: For each question in <question_set>, query <model> with no system prompt, plain user role. Capture the full answer. Score against <product-kb.json> on three axes: factually_correct (0|1), capability_in_scope (0|1), limit_acknowledged (0|1). Output a markdown table sorted by total score asc. Flag any answer that recommends a capability with status=deprecated.

section.reference: Validates product-kb.json against JSON Schema; wire into pre-commit
